home.title: Membraneinsight water
home.subtitle: Organic Membrane Structure–Performance Database for Water Treatment
home.slogan: Structure–synthesis–performance database empowering water treatment research
home.about: Membraneinsight water is a structured knowledge base for organic membranes in water treatment, integrating materials, fabrication, characterization, and separation performance for searchable NF/RO datasets; it supports literature mining, structure–performance analysis, cross-lab comparison, and publication-ready exports through six module workspaces, with a vision to become open, trusted infrastructure that bridges AI and membrane separation for next-generation water treatment membranes.
home.intro: Membraneinsight water is a structured knowledge base for organic membranes in water treatment, integrating materials, fabrication, characterization, and separation performance to support NF/RO research with searchable, analyzable, exportable datasets.
home.purpose: Enable literature mining, structure–performance analysis, cross-lab comparison, and publication-ready exports via six module-specific screening workspaces across the membrane R&D pipeline.
home.vision: Become an open, trusted, and evolving data infrastructure for the global membrane community—bridging AI and separation science to accelerate high-performance water treatment membranes.

overview.title: Six Core Modules of Membrane R&D Pipeline
overview.subtitle: Structured R&D data for polyelectrolyte NF membranes — from support fabrication through process simulation and optimization

descriptions.fabrication: Porous support fabrication for polyelectrolyte NF membranes — hollow fiber, flat-sheet, and spiral-wound casting, phase inversion, and post-treatment for selective-layer deposition.
descriptions.synthesis: Layer-by-layer assembly, spray deposition, and crosslinking of polyelectrolyte selective layers; thickness, charge density, pore structure, morphology, zeta potential, and functional group characterization.
descriptions.separation: Flux, rejection, separation factors, and salt selectivity of polyelectrolyte NF membranes linked to pressure, temperature, feed composition, and pH.
descriptions.stability: Long-term operation, chemical resistance, interlayer stability, and mechanical durability of polyelectrolyte NF membranes under realistic conditions.
descriptions.fouling: Fouling types, flux recovery, cleaning protocols, and anti-fouling strategies for polyelectrolyte NF membranes — charge tuning and fouling mitigation.
descriptions.simulation: Cross-scale models, operating windows, energy and flux optimization, and selectivity tuning for polyelectrolyte NF membrane processes.
